idea-plugin.name: AI Model License Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Reads the open-weight model IDs in your code and names the licence clause that binds you - 22 rules, 17 findings on a 33-line fixture

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → AI Model License Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 22 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/ai-model-license-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/ai-model-license-lint

action.text: AI Model License Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run AI Model License Lint on the file in the editor
